## Phase 2 분석 보고서 요약 + 구현 가이드

이전 세션에서 전체 보고서를 전송했었습니다. Collection A/B 스왑 코드를 확인했고, `swapAlias()` / `resolveTargetIndex()` 등이 ES 9.x Java API Client로 정확하게 구현되어 있습니다. 아래는 backend-dev가 바로 활용할 수 있도록 **indices/template/pipeline/documentanalysis** 구현 가이드를 구체화한 것입니다.

## 1. indices 도메인 (2-3) - ES 9.x API 매핑

### 1-1. 문서 페이지네이션 조회 (from/size)

```kotlin
// IndicesService.kt
fun getDocuments(
    clusterId: String,
    index: String,
    pageNum: Int,
    rowSize: Int,
    docId: String? = null,
): DocumentPagination {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)

    val response = esClient.search({ s ->
        s.index(index)
            .query { q ->
                if (docId != null) {
                    q.ids { i -> i.values(docId) }
                } else {
                    q.matchAll { it }
                }
            }
            .from((pageNum - 1) * rowSize)
            .size(rowSize)
    }, JsonData::class.java)

    // 매핑 정보에서 필드 목록 추출
    val fields = getIndexFields(esClient, index)

    return DocumentPagination(
        fields = fields,
        hits = response.hits().hits().map { hit ->
            DocumentHit(
                id = hit.id()!!,
                source = hit.source()?.toJson()?.let { objectMapper.readValue(it, Map::class.java) as Map<String, Any?> } ?: emptyMap(),
            )
        },
        totalCount = response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0,
        pageNum = pageNum.toLong(),
        rowSize = rowSize.toLong(),
        lastPageNum = calculateLastPage(response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0, rowSize),
    )
}

private fun getIndexFields(client: ElasticsearchClient, index: String): Set<String> {
    val mappingResponse = client.indices().getMapping { it.index(index) }
    return mappingResponse.result().values
        .flatMap { it.mappings().properties().keys }
        .toSet()
}
```

### 1-2. 분석기 실행 (_analyze API)

```kotlin
fun analyzeText(
    clusterId: String,
    index: String,
    analyzer: String,
    text: String,
): List<AnalyzeToken> {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
    val response = esClient.indices().analyze { a ->
        a.index(index)
            .analyzer(analyzer)
            .text(text)
    }
    return response.tokens().map { token ->
        AnalyzeToken(
            token = token.token(),
            startOffset = token.startOffset(),
            endOffset = token.endOffset(),
            type = token.type(),
            position = token.position(),
        )
    }
}
```

### 1-3. 인덱스 매핑 조회

```kotlin
fun getIndexMappings(clusterId: String, index: String): Map<String, Any> {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
    val response = esClient.indices().getMapping { it.index(index) }
    // response.result() → Map<String, IndexMappingRecord>
    return response.result().mapValues { (_, record) ->
        mapOf(
            "properties" to record.mappings().properties().mapValues { (_, prop) ->
                mapOf("type" to prop._kind().name)
            }
        )
    }
}
```

## 2. template 도메인 (2-4) - Composable Index Template

### 2-1. ES 9.x API 매핑 (확정)

| 기능 | ES 9.x REST API | Java API Client 호출 |
|------|-----------------|---------------------|
| Index Template 목록 | `GET /_index_template` | `client.indices().getIndexTemplate()` |
| Index Template 상세 | `GET /_index_template/{name}` | `client.indices().getIndexTemplate(g -> g.name(name))` |
| Index Template 생성/수정 | `PUT /_index_template/{name}` | `client.indices().putIndexTemplate(p -> p.name(name)...)` |
| Index Template 삭제 | `DELETE /_index_template/{name}` | `client.indices().deleteIndexTemplate(d -> d.name(name))` |
| Component Template 목록 | `GET /_component_template` | `client.cluster().getComponentTemplate()` |
| Component Template 상세 | `GET /_component_template/{name}` | `client.cluster().getComponentTemplate(g -> g.name(name))` |
| Component Template 생성/수정 | `PUT /_component_template/{name}` | `client.cluster().putComponentTemplate(p -> p.name(name)...)` |
| Component Template 삭제 | `DELETE /_component_template/{name}` | `client.cluster().deleteComponentTemplate(d -> d.name(name))` |

### 2-2. 구현 가이드

```kotlin
@Service
class IndexTemplateService(private val clientFactory: ElasticsearchClientFactory) {

    fun getTemplates(clusterId: String): List<IndexTemplateInfo> {
        val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
        val response = esClient.indices().getIndexTemplate()
        return response.indexTemplates()
            .filter { !it.name().startsWith(".") }
            .filter { !isElasticBuiltin(it.name()) }
            .map { item ->
                IndexTemplateInfo(
                    name = item.name(),
                    indexPatterns = item.indexTemplate().indexPatterns(),
                    composedOf = item.indexTemplate().composedOf(),
                    priority = item.indexTemplate().priority(),
                    version = item.indexTemplate().version(),
                )
            }
    }

    fun getComponentTemplates(clusterId: String): List<ComponentTemplateInfo> {
        val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
        val response = esClient.cluster().getComponentTemplate()
        return response.componentTemplates()
            .filter { !it.name().startsWith(".") }
            .map { item ->
                ComponentTemplateInfo(
                    name = item.name(),
                    // item.componentTemplate().template() → settings, mappings, aliases
                )
            }
    }

    // 템플릿 코멘트는 ES dsearch-mapping-comments 인덱스에 저장 (기존 로직 유지)
    fun getComments(clusterId: String): List<TemplateComment> {
        val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
        val response = esClient.search({ s ->
            s.index("dsearch-mapping-comments")
                .query { q -> q.matchAll { it } }
                .size(10000)
        }, TemplateComment::class.java)
        return response.hits().hits().mapNotNull { it.source() }
    }

    fun upsertComment(clusterId: String, name: String, data: String, docId: String?) {
        val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
        if (docId != null) {
            esClient.update({ u ->
                u.index("dsearch-mapping-comments").id(docId)
                    .doc(mapOf("name" to name, "data" to data))
            }, Map::class.java)
        } else {
            esClient.index { i ->
                i.index("dsearch-mapping-comments")
                    .document(mapOf("name" to name, "data" to data))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isElasticBuiltin(name: String): Boolean =
        BUILTIN_PREFIXES.any { name.startsWith(it) }

    companion object {
        private val BUILTIN_PREFIXES = listOf(
            "logs-", "metrics-", ".fleet-", "synthetics-",
            "behavioral_analytics-", ".slm-", "ilm-", ".monitoring-",
            ".ml-", ".transform-", ".watch-", ".deprecation-",
        )
    }
}
```

### 2-3. DTO

```kotlin
data class IndexTemplateInfo(
    val name: String,
    val indexPatterns: List<String>,
    val composedOf: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val priority: Long? = null,
    val version: Long? = null,
)

data class ComponentTemplateInfo(
    val name: String,
    val settings: Map<String, Any>? = null,
    val mappings: Map<String, Any>? = null,
    val aliases: Map<String, Any>? = null,
)

data class TemplateComment(
    val name: String,
    val data: String,
)
```

### 2-4. 컨트롤러

```kotlin
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/templates")
class IndexTemplateController(private val templateService: IndexTemplateService) {

    @GetMapping("/comments")
    fun getComments(
        @RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String,
    ): List<TemplateComment> = templateService.getComments(clusterId)

    @PutMapping("/comments")
    fun upsertComment(
        @RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String,
        @RequestBody body: Map<String, String>,
    ) {
        templateService.upsertComment(clusterId, body["name"]!!, body["data"]!!, body["id"])
    }
}
```

## 3. pipeline 도메인 (2-5)

### 3-1. ES 9.x API 매핑

| 기능 | ES 9.x REST API | Java API Client 호출 |
|------|-----------------|---------------------|
| 전체 조회 | `GET /_ingest/pipeline` | `client.ingest().getPipeline()` |
| 단건 조회 | `GET /_ingest/pipeline/{id}` | `client.ingest().getPipeline(g -> g.id(id))` |
| 생성/수정 | `PUT /_ingest/pipeline/{id}` | `client.ingest().putPipeline(p -> p.id(id)...)` |
| 삭제 | `DELETE /_ingest/pipeline/{id}` | `client.ingest().deletePipeline(d -> d.id(id))` |
| 시뮬레이션 | `POST /_ingest/pipeline/_simulate` | `client.ingest().simulate(s -> s...)` |

### 3-2. 구현 가이드

**주의**: 레거시는 Low-Level Client로 ES 원시 JSON을 그대로 반환했음. 신규에서는 2가지 선택지가 있음:

- **(A) Typed 응답**: Java API Client의 typed 객체 사용 → 안전하지만 프론트엔드와 응답 형태 불일치 가능
- **(B) Raw JSON 유지**: Low-Level Client(`Rest5Client`)로 원시 JSON 반환 → 프론트엔드 호환 보장

**권장: (B) Low-Level Client Raw JSON 유지** — 프론트엔드가 ES 원시 JSON을 직접 처리하는 구조이므로.

```kotlin
@Service
class PipelineService(private val clientFactory: ElasticsearchClientFactory) {

    fun list(clusterId: String): String {
        val restClient = clientFactory.getLowLevelClient(clusterId)
        val request = Request("GET", "/_ingest/pipeline")
        val response = restClient.performRequest(request)
        return EntityUtils.toString(response.entity)
    }

    fun get(clusterId: String, name: String): String {
        val restClient = clientFactory.getLowLevelClient(clusterId)
        val request = Request("GET", "/_ingest/pipeline/$name")
        val response = restClient.performRequest(request)
        return EntityUtils.toString(response.entity)
    }

    fun put(clusterId: String, name: String, body: String): String {
        val restClient = clientFactory.getLowLevelClient(clusterId)
        val request = Request("PUT", "/_ingest/pipeline/$name")
        request.setJsonEntity(body)
        val response = restClient.performRequest(request)
        return EntityUtils.toString(response.entity)
    }

    fun delete(clusterId: String, name: String): String {
        val restClient = clientFactory.getLowLevelClient(clusterId)
        val request = Request("DELETE", "/_ingest/pipeline/$name")
        val response = restClient.performRequest(request)
        return EntityUtils.toString(response.entity)
    }

    fun simulate(clusterId: String, name: String, body: String, verbose: Boolean): String {
        val restClient = clientFactory.getLowLevelClient(clusterId)
        val endpoint = if (verbose) {
            "/_ingest/pipeline/$name/_simulate?verbose"
        } else {
            "/_ingest/pipeline/$name/_simulate"
        }
        val request = Request("POST", endpoint)
        request.setJsonEntity(body)
        val response = restClient.performRequest(request)
        return EntityUtils.toString(response.entity)
    }
}
```

### 3-3. 컨트롤러

```kotlin
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/pipeline")
class PipelineController(private val pipelineService: PipelineService) {

    @GetMapping("/list")
    fun list(@RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String): ResponseEntity<String> =
        ResponseEntity.ok(pipelineService.list(clusterId))

    @GetMapping("/{name}")
    fun get(
        @RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String,
        @PathVariable name: String,
    ): ResponseEntity<String> = ResponseEntity.ok(pipelineService.get(clusterId, name))

    @PutMapping("/{name}")
    fun put(
        @RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String,
        @PathVariable name: String,
        @RequestBody body: String,
    ): ResponseEntity<String> = ResponseEntity.ok(pipelineService.put(clusterId, name, body))

    @PostMapping("/{name}")
    fun simulate(
        @RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String,
        @PathVariable name: String,
        @RequestParam(defaultValue = "false") isDetail: Boolean,
        @RequestBody body: String,
    ): ResponseEntity<String> = ResponseEntity.ok(pipelineService.simulate(clusterId, name, body, isDetail))

    @DeleteMapping("/{name}")
    fun delete(
        @RequestHeader("cluster-id") clusterId: String,
        @PathVariable name: String,
    ): ResponseEntity<String> = ResponseEntity.ok(pipelineService.delete(clusterId, name))
}
```

## 4. documentanalysis 도메인 (2-6)

### 4-1. Term Vector API (ES 9.x)

```kotlin
@Service
class DocumentAnalysisService(private val clientFactory: ElasticsearchClientFactory) {

    fun analyzeDocuments(
        clusterId: String,
        index: String,
        query: String?,   // ES 쿼리 JSON (null이면 matchAll)
        size: Int = 100,
    ): DocumentAnalysisResult {
        val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)

        // 1. 인덱스 매핑에서 analyzer 설정된 필드 추출
        val analyzerFields = getAnalyzerFields(esClient, index)
        if (analyzerFields.isEmpty()) {
            throw NoSuchAnalyzerException("분석기가 설정된 필드가 없습니다: $index")
        }

        // 2. 문서 검색
        val searchResponse = esClient.search({ s ->
            s.index(index)
                .query { q ->
                    if (query != null) {
                        q.withJson(StringReader(query))
                    } else {
                        q.matchAll { it }
                    }
                }
                .size(size)
        }, JsonData::class.java)

        // 3. 각 문서에 대해 Term Vector 추출
        val analysis = searchResponse.hits().hits().map { hit ->
            val termVectorResponse = esClient.termvectors { t ->
                t.index(index)
                    .id(hit.id()!!)
                    .fields(analyzerFields.map { it.first })  // 필드명 목록
                    .termStatistics(true)
                    .fieldStatistics(false)
            }
            DocAnalysis(
                docId = hit.id()!!,
                source = hit.source(),
                termVectors = termVectorResponse.termVectors().mapValues { (_, tv) ->
                    tv.terms().map { (term, info) ->
                        TermInfo(term = term, freq = info.termFreq()?.toInt() ?: 0)
                    }
                },
            )
        }

        return DocumentAnalysisResult(
            index = index,
            isSuccess = true,
            analysis = analysis,
        )
    }

    private fun getAnalyzerFields(
        client: ElasticsearchClient,
        index: String,
    ): List<Pair<String, String>> {
        val mappingResponse = client.indices().getMapping { it.index(index) }
        // analyzer 또는 search_analyzer가 설정된 필드만 추출
        return mappingResponse.result().values
            .flatMap { it.mappings().properties().entries }
            .filter { (_, prop) ->
                prop.isText && (prop.text().analyzer() != null || prop.text().searchAnalyzer() != null)
            }
            .map { (name, prop) ->
                name to (prop.text().analyzer() ?: "standard")
            }
    }
}
```

### 4-2. SearchQuery CRUD (dsearch-analysis-query 인덱스)

```kotlin
fun getSearchQueries(clusterId: String): List<SearchQuery> {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
    val response = esClient.search({ s ->
        s.index("dsearch-analysis-query")
            .query { q -> q.matchAll { it } }
            .size(10000)
    }, SearchQuery::class.java)
    return response.hits().hits().map { hit ->
        hit.source()!!.copy(id = hit.id())
    }
}

fun saveSearchQuery(clusterId: String, query: SearchQuery): String {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
    val response = esClient.index { i ->
        i.index("dsearch-analysis-query")
            .document(query)
    }
    return response.id()
}

fun updateSearchQuery(clusterId: String, id: String, query: SearchQuery) {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
    esClient.index { i ->
        i.index("dsearch-analysis-query").id(id)
            .document(query)
    }
}

fun deleteSearchQuery(clusterId: String, id: String) {
    val esClient = clientFactory.getClient(clusterId)
    esClient.delete { d ->
        d.index("dsearch-analysis-query").id(id)
    }
}

data class SearchQuery(
    val id: String? = null,
    val name: String,
    val index: String,
    val query: String,  // ES 쿼리 JSON 문자열
)
```

## 5. Collection A/B 스왑 코드 검증 결과

`CollectionService.kt`의 `swapAlias()`, `resolveTargetIndex()` 구현을 확인했습니다.

**검증 결과: 정확하게 구현됨**

- `client.indices().getAlias { it.name(baseId) }` → `.aliases().keys` 로 현재 인덱스 확인 
- `Action.of { a -> a.remove { } }` + `Action.of { a -> a.add { } }` → 원자적 교체 
- `buildList { }` 로 oldIndex가 없을 때 remove 생략 → 초기 생성 케이스 처리 

**한 가지 보완 제안**: `must_exist` 파라미터 활용
```kotlin
// 현재 코드에서 remove 액션에 mustExist(false)를 명시적으로 추가하면
// 레이스 컨디션으로 이미 Alias가 해제된 경우의 에러를 방지할 수 있음
a.remove { it.index(oldIndex).alias(baseId).mustExist(false) }
```
이것은 선택 사항이며, 현재 코드도 `runCatching`으로 에러를 처리하고 있어 문제없습니다.

---

## 6. Rate Limiting 권장사항 (2-7)

**Bucket4j + HandlerInterceptor** 권장 (이전 보고서에서 상세 코드 제공 완료)

의존성: `implementation("com.bucket4j:bucket4j-core:8.14.0")`

적용 대상: `/elasticsearch/**` (ES 프록시) 경로에만 한정
기본 한도: IP 기반 분당 100회 (설정 가능)

---

backend-dev에게 이 가이드를 전달하면 indices(2-3) 구현을 바로 시작할 수 있습니다. 특히 **pipeline 도메인은 Low-Level Client Raw JSON 방식**을 권장한다는 점을 전달해 주세요. 프론트엔드가 ES 원시 JSON을 직접 파싱하는 구조이므로 typed 응답으로 변환하면 불필요한 변환 비용이 발생합니다.
